propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion runs exhaust the bounded request budget with zero incremental criterion verdicts banked, violating the documented Incremental banking contract and replacing evidence-backed PASS/FAIL with CompletionRecoveryError.

Pydantic AI executes a model response's tool batch concurrently, so prompt-only serialization instructions cannot enforce one governed evidence action per response, allowing deferred record calls until budget exhaustion.

The completion-only wrapper policy atomically claims one governed action per run_step, counts unique evidence responses per criterion, and invokes fallback met=false on the third evidence response if still unbanked, guaranteeing progress before budget exhaustion.
System-level finite state machine guidance and data-only manifest replace subjective banking conditions, establishing an authoritative record commit boundary independent of model confidence judgment.
Private CompletionEvidencePolicy metadata and composed wrapper layers enforce the bounded banking contract without changing public API, schema, CLI entrypoints, or vocabulary surfaces.
